snippet.title: Kaiju Control Force - Story Trailer
snippet.description:
THE STORY SO FAR

When kaijus entered our plane they mostly ignored us, roaming the world without interfering human affairs. The KAIJU CONTROL FORCE was created to study their behaviour and stop them if necessary.

10 years ago, one kaiju emerged from the sea and walked straight into our city, destroying everything in its path...

... and 10 years later that kaiju is still lurking among the ruins of our city—angry, violent, and somehow... uncomfortable?

 FEATURES:

- 4 playable characters
- Deal with 14 bioengineered rats designed to fight kaijus
- 6 classic platform-and-ladder stages, procedurally generated for endless variety
- Thrilling hacking mechanics! hehe
- A beautifully illustrated comic telling the story

Local multiplayer for two players, online with Remote Play Together!

Get it now! https://store.steampowered.com/app/3268730/Kaiju_Control_Force/
